home.title: Read the Quran through the roots of its words
home.lead: Tap any word in the mushaf to see its meaning and its root, how often that root occurs in the Quran, and every word built from it — then follow it through every verse, or open its map.
home.how1Body: Every word of the mushaf is real, selectable text you can tap.
home.how2Body: Most words go back to a root of three letters, from which a whole family of words branches out.
home.how3Body: See every form of the root in the Quran, where each occurs, and what the lexicons and tafsirs say.
home.how4Body: Follow the family on an open canvas: the root, its forms, and the verses.
home.trustBody: The Quran text is from the King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, shown exactly as published and checked automatically. Morphology is from the Quranic Arabic Corpus, and every claim names its source.

footer.label: Site links
footer.attribution: Quran text: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, with the Tanzil Project text (tanzil.net) for verification. Morphology: the Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com). Every tafsir and translation is credited to its author and source where it appears.
footer.integrity: The Quranic text is shown exactly as in its source and its integrity is checked automatically on every data update.
footer.noAds: No ads, no tracking — a project in service of the Book of Allah.

roots.howWeCountBody: “Occurrences”: every word of the mushaf that goes back to this root, counted once (following the Quranic Arabic Corpus word division). “Verses”: the number of distinct verses in which the root appears. “Lemmas”: the distinct dictionary forms. Other sites that count verses instead of words will show different numbers.
